title: GUVI: Power of Two (Bitwise Check)
description: Given an integer `n`, return `True` if it is a power of two. Otherwise, return `False`. You must use bitwise operations.
solution:
def is_power_of_two(n: int) -> bool:
    return n > 0 and (n & (n - 1)) == 0
explanation: A power of two has exactly one bit set. n & (n - 1) clears that bit, resulting in 0 in O(1) time.
